Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) is a US semiconductor company based in Santa Clara, California. It designs CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs and systems on a chip, and sells into PCs, gaming, embedded systems and the data center, where its GPUs compete for AI training and inference work.
